services.name: Castle Adventure 5-Mile Kayak Trip
services.desc: Duration 2 - 4 hours (approximate) About Our most popular paddling adventure takes you by the Historic Loveland Castle! (Castle Tour not included) The average Castle Adventure trip lasts 2-4 hours and travels 5 miles. Check in at Loveland Paddlesports and let our friendly drivers transport you up to Carl Rahe Park. Our knowledgeable and experienced staff will be there to greet and assist you. Please don't hesitate to ask if you have questions or need help. services.name: Isabella Burgers and Brews Float
services.desc: Overview Park at Lake Isabella and let us shuttle you to Loveland Paddlesports where you will receive your life vest, paddle, and watch a short safety video. From there, you will launch and paddle 3 miles down to Lake Isabella Park where you can enjoy the live music. Burgers, veggie burgers, hot dogs and refreshing beverages will be available for purchase.
